revision: v7 — prefer ui-monospace and remove explicit Yu Gothic
scope: 4 representative pages × 5 widths × 2 themes = 40 checks; not a full 33-page rerun
focusedChecks: Code begins with ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas
No SF Mono, SFMono-Regular or Yu Gothic named in CSS
Body ends in sans-serif; code ends in monospace
Code feature settings normal, font kerning none
Inline probe paragraphs have equal height with and without padding
limitations: Safari SF Mono and Japanese fallback not tested on device
Computed font stacks do not identify actual glyph fonts or generic-family support
No native zoom or new end-to-end clipboard paste verification
